@thm-bayes-posterior is
[Bayes' theorem](https://morrison-lab.github.io/rme/chapters/probability.html#thm-bayes)
for events, restated for densities.
Here $\p(\vy \mid \theta)$, viewed as a function of $\theta$,
is the [likelihood](intro-MLEs.qmd#def-lik) $\Lik(\theta)$.
@cor-bayes-proportional is the workhorse of applied Bayesian analysis:
it identifies the posterior from the shape of likelihood times prior,
without computing the integral $\p(\vy)$,
and it is what makes the [simulation methods of MCMC](mcmc.qmd#sec-foundations) possible
[@dobson4e, Chapter 12, p. 272].
